cd /work/tests && python3 - <<'PY'
import random, subprocess, os, tempfile
rnd=random.Random(777)
seen=set(); out=[]
while len(out)<20000:
    L=rnd.choice([0,4,8,16,24,32,40,48,56,60,62,63,64])
    k=0 if L==0 else rnd.getrandbits(64)&(((1<<L)-1)<<(64-L))
    if (k,L) in seen: continue
    seen.add((k,L)); out.append((k,L,rnd.randrange(0,4294967296)))
tmp=tempfile.mkdtemp()
fib=os.path.join(tmp,'f'); img=os.path.join(tmp,'i'); tr=os.path.join(tmp,'t')
with open(fib,'w') as f:
    for k,L,h in out:
        f.write("%x:%x:%x:%x::/%d %d\n"%((k>>48)&0xffff,(k>>32)&0xffff,(k>>16)&0xffff,k&0xffff,L,h))
with open(tr,'w') as f:
    for _ in range(5000):
        k=rnd.getrandbits(64)
        f.write("%x:%x:%x:%x:1:2:3:4\n"%((k>>48)&0xffff,(k>>32)&0xffff,(k>>16)&0xffff,k&0xffff))
p=subprocess.run(['/work/submit/planb64','build',fib,img],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
rows=open(img).read().strip().split('\n')
n=int(rows[1]); print("records",len(out),"rows",n)
r1=subprocess.run(['/work/tests/ref',fib,tr],capture_output=True,text=True)
r2=subprocess.run(['/work/submit/planb64','lookup',img,tr,'scalar'],capture_output=True,text=True)
r3=subprocess.run(['/work/submit/planb64','lookup',img,tr,'batch','37'],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert r1.returncode==0 and r2.returncode==0 and r3.returncode==0, (r1.stderr,r2.stderr,r3.stderr)
assert r1.stdout==r2.stdout==r3.stdout, "MISMATCH"
print("20k-prefix / 5k-query differential vs independent reference: OK (scalar + batch)")
# minimality + brute-force spot check on the image itself
def brute(entries,key):
    best=(-1,-1)
    for k2,L,h in entries:
        mask=0 if L==0 else ((1<<L)-1)<<(64-L)
        if (key&mask)==(k2&mask) and L>best[1]: best=(h,L)
    return best
body=rows[2:]
for i,b in enumerate(body):
    f0,f1,f2=b.split(' ')
    k=int(f0,16); h=int(f1); l=int(f2)
    assert (h,l)==brute(out,k), (i,b)
    if i>0:
        pk=int(body[i-1].split(' ')[0],16)
        assert brute(out,k-1)!=(h,l), ("redundant",i,b)
print("image minimality + full brute-force check at every change point: OK")
PY
